summary: Iter6 testing of Quote Builder (Cotizaciones) + team-registration logo upload. Backend: 102/102 pytest pass (84 regression from iter5 + 18 new iter6 tests covering /api/event-types schema, /api/quotes/calculate math [festival/Sub-12/gold/double/4pax/3nights=1450; all-addons scenario], validation errors for invalid category-for-event/event_type/tier/room_type [400 & 422], POST /api/quotes auth-required creates pendiente quote matching calculate, /api/quotes/mine scoping, admin-only /api/quotes [403 for team], PUT status admin-only with invalid-status 400, payment-proof owner+admin allowed / stranger 403). Frontend: /cotizar renders step-by-step (Evento/Categoría/Hospedaje/PAX/Adicionales), selecting Festival+Sub-12+Gold+Doble+4pax+3nights shows correct live total $1450 in right Resumen panel via /api/quotes/calculate; navbar has Cotizar link; /registro-equipo has 'Escudo del club' file input with live blob preview after picking a small PNG.

issues: 'Tipo de habitación' uses a native <select> element rather than the project's shadcn Select. It works but breaks visual consistency (different font, no custom caret, no testid).

action_items: (Optional) Replace native <select> 'Tipo de habitación' in Cotizar.jsx with shadcn Select + data-testid for consistency.
Continue the server.py split backlog from iter5 (file now ~1444 lines with 11 new quote-related lines + QuoteIn model).
Consider adding data-testid on Cotizar event cards, category pills, lodging cards, and Resumen total for robust UI regression tests (none were missing-blocker for this iter though).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1444 lines - far above the 700-line threshold flagged since iter3. Quote endpoints add ~90 lines to the monolith. Split into routers/quotes.py.

POST /api/quotes does not validate that the authenticated user is a team-manager (or admin). Currently any authenticated user (including 'family' role) can create a quote. If quote creation is intended only for team managers, add require_admin_or_team or similar. If intentionally open, confirm in PRD.

PUT /api/quotes/{qid}/payment-proof accepts payload: dict without Pydantic validation - no shape/type check on 'url'. Create a PaymentProofIn(BaseModel){ url: HttpUrl | str } so malformed requests return 422 instead of silently writing '' to payment_proof_url.
update_quote_status uses ?status=... query param with a 4-value allow-list but no Pydantic enum. Same pattern as team/player status. Low risk but consider making an Enum.
_calculate_quote is synchronous and re-runs on every POST /quotes. For race-condition safety prefer await + server-side idempotency key (low-prio).

Quote doc persists snapshot of lodging_subtotal/total_amount/rate_per_person_night at creation time. If LODGING_TIERS/ADDON_PRICES are later changed, old quotes still carry the snapshot - good. But consider also snapshotting pricing_version for audit.
There is no DELETE /api/quotes/{qid} endpoint. Admin cannot remove an erroneous quote, and owner cannot cancel one. Consider DELETE (admin) + /cancel (owner) flows.
Cotizar.jsx uses a native <select> for room-type rather than shadcn Select - inconsistent UX and missing data-testid, complicating e2e tests.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% - /cotizar full happy-path verified with correct live total; /registro-equipo logo picker+preview verified. Admin /admin/cotizaciones UI (dropdown status change) was NOT exercised via Playwright because the equivalent PUT /api/quotes/{id}/status path is already covered by backend tests and the admin routes follow the same layout pattern confirmed in iter5; main agent can self-test by logging in as admin and opening /admin/cotizaciones.

test_credentials: admin@futuresoccercup.com / FSCAdmin2025! (verified). Team managers created per-test via /api/auth/register-team with TEST_iter6_*@test.com.
seed_data_creation: TEST_ITER6_TEAM_* teams and TEST_iter6_*@test.com users are cleaned up by module fixture (teams deleted via admin DELETE). One or two residual quote docs (pendiente/aprobada) may remain in db.quotes for the deleted team - no DELETE /api/quotes endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/results.xml → 102 tests across 6 files (backend_test.py=24, test_new_features.py=20, test_iter3_fixtures.py=11, test_iter4_approvals.py=16, test_iter5_bulk_import.py=13, test_iter6_quotes.py=18). New iter6 endpoints: GET /api/event-types (public), POST /api/quotes/calculate (public, Literal validation 422 on bad event/tier/room), POST /api/quotes (auth, returns quote with status=pendiente & calc snapshot), GET /api/quotes/mine (auth), GET /api/quotes (admin), PUT /api/quotes/{id}/status?status= (admin; allowed: pendiente|aprobada|rechazada|pagada), PUT /api/quotes/{id}/payment-proof body {url} (owner or admin). Frontend data-testids are mostly absent on Cotizar.jsx event/category/tier cards - tests resort to text selectors.
rca of the issue: N/A - no functional issues found. One UX consistency note (native select on Cotizar) and tech-debt comments only.
